correctness.rationale: For arbitrary noncontracting real Hilbert embeddings, m alternating rim points pairwise distance at least 2 and hub distance at most sqrt(T); the centroid identity forces T>=2-2/m and equality rigidity. Explicit 2m-by-2m Gram blocks have Fourier eigenvalues 2±2u[1+4(1-u²)/m]; for m>=8 monotonicity bounds u[1+4(1-u²)/m]<=1, and m=7 has a strict rational cosine estimate. A direct exact metric-pair check gives all squared distances T, 4, or 4+2/m, so the upper construction matches. The actual checker passed exact Schur-complement PSD and every pair for m=7..18. Infinite validity is analytical.
